id: \rSakura: My Eevee will evolve one day.
en: \rSakura: My Eevee will evolve one day.
it: \rSakura: Un giorno il mio Eevee si evolverà.

id: \rSakura: I've gotten stronger. I'm sure you have too.
en: \rSakura: I've gotten stronger. I'm sure you have too.
it: \rSakura: Sono diventata più forte. E sono sicura che anche tu lo sia diventato.

id: \rTamao: The power of our Eevees are unrivaled.
en: \rTamao: The power of our Eevees are unrivaled.
it: \rTamao: La potenza dei nostri Eevee non ha rivali.

id: \rSatsuki: You seem ready for a battle. I don't want to disappoint you.
en: \rSatsuki: You seem ready for a battle. I don't want to disappoint you.
it: \rSatsuki: Sembri pronto per una lotta. Non voglio deluderti.

id: \rTamao: The power of our Eevee forms will beat you.
en: \rTamao: The power of our Eevee forms will beat you.
it: \rTamao: La potenza delle nostre forme di Eevee ti sconfiggerà.

id: \rKoume: You must be getting tired by now.
en: \rKoume: You must be getting tired by now.

id: \rSakura: I'm not that powerful but I will try my best.
en: \rSakura: I'm not that powerful but I will try my best.
it: \rSakura: Non sono così forte, ma farò del mio meglio.

id: \rSatsuki: You did excellent. Take this as our praise.
en: \rSatsuki: You did excellent. Take this as our praise.
it: \rSatsuki: Sei stato eccellente. Accetta questo come nostro omaggio.

id: \rSatsuki: Feel free to come back anytime.
en: \rSatsuki: Feel free to come back anytime.

id: \rSumomo: I bet you came here to battle Morty.
en: \rSumomo: I bet you came here to battle Morty.
it: \rSumomo: Scommetto che sei venuto qui per sfidare Angelo.

id: \rKoume: We practice and battle everyday to keep our strength up.
en: \rKoume: We practice and battle everyday to keep our strength up.
it: \rKoume: Ci alleniamo e lottiamo ogni giorno per mantenerci in forma.
